packets.responsibility: Builds the #frame-grid keyframe-track row for one holder/prop pair: an absolutely-positioned overlay <svg> (per-frame duration blocks + inter-key change connectors), one '.fc' cell per project frame carrying a keyframe diamond (or ease boxes) when a key exists there, the complete key-selection/drag/context-menu pipeline, and a final re-parent of the svg to the end of rowEl so it paints (and hit-tests) above every '.fc' cell.
dom_contract: rowEl itself: innerHTML cleared, position:relative set, then tagged with plain JS properties rowEl._smHolder=ld and rowEl._smProp=prop (10684) — NOT a WeakMap, so the marquee/selection code can recover 'which holder/prop does this row belong to' from a bare DOM hit-test; rowEl.classList.toggle('prop-selected', isMotionPropSelected(ld,prop)) (10685).
Overlay <svg> (10688-10691, appended first at 10691, RE-APPENDED last at 11075): width=state.totalFrames*FC, height=ROW_H, inline style position:absolute;left:0;top:0;pointer-events:none.
Duration-block <rect class="motion-key-durblock" data-ki="<index>">, one per key, only when FC>=18 (10705-10716): x=k.frame*FC, width=FC, height=ROW_H, fill=k.color||'var(--accent)', opacity 0.13.

Connector <rect class="motion-key-connect"> between consecutive keys whose value actually differs (10732-10794): height 5 (barH), border-radius 2, x/width span the two keys' frames*FC, class gains ' sel' when both endpoint keys are isKeySelected, and ' tinted' (+ CSS var --key-color) only when both endpoints share the SAME k.color; data-i=<segment index>; pointer-events:auto punches through the parent svg's pointer-events:none so only this rect is a real hit target.
One '.fc.motion-fc' div per frame (10796-10799, appended at 11057), class gains ' cur' on state.currentFrame, dataset.frame=fi.

Keyframe diamond <div class="motion-key <hold|linear|smooth>"> when a key exists at that frame (10800-10828): class also gains ' cur'/' sel'; class 'tinted' + CSS var --key-color when k.color is set; title = '<prop label> · image <n+1> · <interpolation label>'; inline width/height override (Math.max(3,FC)) only when 0<FC<7, to keep the fixed 7px CSS diamond from visually overlapping its neighbor at low zoom.

gesture_pipeline: Connector mousedown (10777-10791): e.stopPropagation(); pushUndo(); sets _keyAnchor to the FIRST key's frame; arms window._motionConnectDrag={ld,prop,a:keyA,b:keyB,startX,startAFrame,startBFrame,startScrollLeft,retime:e.altKey}; sets cursor to 'e-resize' (retime) or 'ew-resize'; goToFrame(keyA.frame); renderTimeline(). Cmd/Ctrl-click a diamond (10874-10887): selection-only — toggles this key in/out of _motionKeySel via setKeySel, sets _keyAnchor, renderTimeline(). No pushUndo, no drag armed, no document write beyond the selection array.

Shift-click a diamond (10888-10916): selection-only — reuses the marquee's own applyMarqueeSelection(x0,y0,x1,y1) between the frozen _keyAnchor cell and the clicked cell (byte-identical to a literal marquee drag over the currently-rendered rows), or falls back to a plain single-key select+anchor when no anchor cell is resolvable; renderTimeline(). Plain click on an ALREADY-selected diamond (10924-10950): navigates via goToFrame first and re-reads the live key object off the refreshed track; pushUndo(); Alt+drag with >=2 selected keys builds skew rows (buildKeyRows(), C02-owned) and arms window._motionSkewDrag (mode:'bottom'); otherwise arms window._motionKeyDrag as a GROUP drag (fields below); renderTimeline().

Plain click on an UNSELECTED diamond (10951-10962): pushUndo() (shared with the branch above, line 10936, before the isKeySelected branch); setKeySel to just this key; sets _keyAnchor; arms window._motionKeyDrag as a SINGLE-key drag; renderTimeline().
Click on empty '.fc' (no key, 10963-10965): startMarquee(e) (C02-owned) — a rectangular multi-key marquee select, not a drag of an existing key.
Every '.fc' mousedown branch ends with goToFrame(frameIdx) (10966), unconditionally, even the marquee/no-key branch — the playhead always follows a click on the grid.

renderTracksFor_contract: Early return (11081) when isPropFiltered(prop) (C02-owned, motion.js:625) or when (_hideUnanimated (module var, motion.js:599) is true AND propHasContent(holder,prop) (motion.js:624) is false) — for a non-animated, non-static prop under the 'hide unanimated' toggle, renderTracksFor emits ZERO rows and returns before creating the row div.

Otherwise emits exactly one '.frow.motion-track-row' row (11082-11084) plus at most two additional '.frow.motion-track-spacer' rows (11099-11104 for an open expression editor on this exact holder+prop; 11112-11117 for an open anchor-grid on this exact holder when prop==='anchor') — so one call emits 1, 2 or 3 rows total, never more.

Spacer height is read live off the PANEL side's own rendered element (document.querySelector('#layer-list .motion-expr-editor') / '.motion-anchor-grid-row'), falling back to a hardcoded 90px / 60px only when that element is absent — relies on renderLayerList() always having already run before renderTimeline() in every call site in this file (per the inline comment, 11097-11098), a cross-file ordering invariant this packet does not itself enforce.

source_consumers.disposition: Zero calls to saveActiveLayerFrame (or any other persistence function) occur anywhere in motion.js:10672-11125 (grep-verified). Every document write in this span — direct tr.keys.splice on delete, direct key.hold flip, and the C02-owned setKeyAtCurrentFrame/openMotionEaseEditor/applyEasyEase/etc. delegated writes — lands on holder.motion[prop] (or a live key object inside it), which C19g's already-existing exportJSON/save path serializes without any local save call from this span.
No parser is implemented in this span. C19g's exportJSON/import already serializes/restores the whole elementMotion/motion object this span reads and mutates (cited by name only, not re-mapped).

pushUndo() precedes every DIRECT write in this span (connector-drag arm 10779, plain-click drag arm 10936, delete-key 10974/menu, add-key 10977/menu, edit-ease-curve 10983/menu, make/remove-hold 10989/menu) — six call sites. Cmd/Ctrl-click and Shift-click (selection-only) never call pushUndo. The 'Delete this key' branch has NO renderLayerList() call unlike every sibling write branch (asymmetry recorded, not asserted as a bug) — it still gets renderTimeline()+conditional renderNow(). Interpolation-preset/batch-op menu items (Easy Ease, Linear, Distribute, Flip, Subdivide, Color, Select-Nth, Keep-Random, Invert) have NO local pushUndo in this span; each delegates entirely to its own C02-owned function, which is expected to own its own undo per that function's own definition (not re-verified here).

setKeySel (C02-owned) is the sole selection-array writer, called from Cmd/Ctrl-click, Shift-click (fallback branch), and both plain-click branches (selected/unselected). _keyAnchor (module-level var) is set at five sites (10781, 10882, 10912, 10938, 10953) tracking the last-clicked key's frame for the next Shift-click's rectangle anchor. isKeySelected/isPrimarySelectedKey (C02-owned) gate rendering only, never mutate selection.

A key's .frame is never written directly by this span (only origFrame is SNAPSHOTTED into the drag-state objects for a later sibling-owned pointermove/pointerup to apply the delta); a key's .hold is toggled directly (context menu); a key is deleted via direct tr.keys.splice; a key is added via the C02-owned setKeyAtCurrentFrame; ease/interpolation edits delegate entirely to C02-owned openMotionEaseEditor/applyEasyEase/setKeyInterp. Ease boxes (buildKeyEaseBox) are only APPENDED here, gated on isPrimarySelectedKey and the absence of an active window._motionKeyDrag/_motionSkewDrag; their own value-edit handlers are out of this span.

renderLayerList()+renderTimeline() are paired at every write branch EXCEPT the two exceptions recorded above ('Delete this key' calls renderTimeline() alone; 'Edit ease curve' calls neither, delegating to openMotionEaseEditor's own refresh) and EXCEPT the selection-only Cmd/Shift-click branches (renderTimeline() alone, correctly — selection changes only the grid side's .sel classes/ease-box visibility, never a panel-side row's content). A conditional SMEngineBridge.renderNow() (object-truthiness only) follows most but not all write branches (absent after 'Edit ease curve' and after the interpolation-preset/batch-op delegations).

No export payload is emitted from this span. C19g-owned exportJSON later serializes whatever holder.motion[prop].keys this span (or its C02-delegated helpers) leaves behind; this artifact does not verify that serialization.

Multiple callbacks conditionally call SMEngineBridge.renderNow(), testing object truthiness only — a shared render-request bridge, not proof of native IPC. No Tauri command or filesystem call is reachable from this span.
